root_cause: Every candidate is named by its own run ledger under .agent/ — the run.json "branch" field is the run's execution identity, and resolve_run requires it to equal the branch registered in .agent/active-runs.json. The carrier scan therefore reports 'referenced by runtime carrier' and the lane fails closed. That field cannot be cleared or repointed without falsifying the recorded ledger identity, so retirement is refused by design.
